_derivation: bpp = kbps/(fps*pixels). Floor rung 0 (2829 kbps) -> 0.0480 bpp; top rung 2 (10303 kbps) -> 0.175 bpp. Encode size is a mult-of-8 16:9 frame (venc requires height % 8 == 0) that clears the 0.04 bpp floor at rung 0. 1024x576 is exact 16:9; 960x540 (the raw bpp pick) is rejected by venc. Rung bitrates are §9.5 derived from the Pass 122 table (table_version 0x80).
_apply: venc fields go to waybeam_venc (sensor.mode and video0.size are restart_required, so this is a pre-flight choice); link fields are merged into /etc/waybeam-link/craft.json. Restart venc (S95waybeam) then the link (S96waybeam-link), then re-scout + quickconnect — a craft restart leaves CSA silently dead otherwise (B9).
